brief.text: Closed-End Funds dominate today's cluster activity, with five separate funds—including BPRE, PSUS, CRAFX, NXG, and SWZ—attracting multi-buyer interest. FUL stands out for broad internal participation, drawing purchases from an unusually high eight individual insiders totaling $1,123,318, closely followed by RAPP with six buyers totaling $1,664,825. Meanwhile, BORR represents the single largest total capital commitment by a wide margin, where three insiders combined for $57,144,458 in total purchases, far outpacing BPRE's $32,812,834 cluster total and CRBG's notable $7,684,334 individual institutional buy.
